body:
Founder direction: leave the whitepaper up but mark it clearly superseded. README.md's crypto whitepaper (Bonded Coordination -- LEMIGOG/SkateChain/Bonded Production/Bonded Flourishing four-layer token/staking/bonding architecture) had been pasted in as one giant unstructured run-on block, mid-way through an unrelated architecture list (splitting the Web & Tooling section in half). Reformatted into real, readable markdown (headers/bullets/math notation preserved, zero content cut) as its own '## Whitepapers' section, with the founder's exact dated notice ('Superseded -- September 2026...') placed directly above it, and a top-of-README pointer linking down to it. Fixed the Web & Tooling list back to one contiguous section (Static Site Generator/Lightweight Web Server/Witch Editor/Turtle Library) as a byproduct of untangling the whitepaper text from it. skateboard commit d3b7b30.

⚓ ☃
title: Bonded Coordination crypto whitepaper marked superseded, reformatted
